explanation: Voltmarkt rolls product indices up by weighting each one by its own units sold: (108 x 40 + 94 x 160) / (40 + 160) = (4,320 + 15,040) / 200 = 96.8, slightly cheaper than the market. A simple average of the two indices gives 101.0 and wrongly says more expensive, because it lets the soundbar, with a quarter of the cable's units, count as much as the cable.
